kicker: Customer khush gaya, review nahi diya
title: Khush customer *khud review nahi* deta. Usse poochna padta hai.
fix_label: Service ke 2 ghante baad ye bhejo 👇
message:
Hi [naam] ✨ aaj ka [service] kaisa laga?
Achha laga ho to 30 second ka review bahut help karega: [Google review link]
Kuch theek nahi laga to seedha yahin batao, hum fix karenge.
why: 2 ghante baad naya look fresh hota hai. *Direct link* = 1 tap. Shikayat private mein aati hai, Google pe nahi.
caption:
Aapke 100 khush customers mein se shayad 2 review dete hain. Gussa wala customer 100% deta hai. 💇‍♀️

Fix: har service ke 2 ghante baad 1 message
✅ "Kaisa laga?"
✅ Direct Google review link
✅ "Kuch galat ho to yahin batao"

Isse reviews badhte hain AUR bad review Google pe jaane se pehle aap tak aata hai.
